title: The Bukele method: will Salvadoran leader's strong-arm tactics work for Haiti?
summary: Haitians are hailing the Bukele method. Citizens of the Americas’ poorest nation cheering the Salvadoran president’s ’shoot first, ask questions later’ method of dealing with the gangs that have overrun their country the past six years. contentText: Haitians are hailing the Bukele method. Citizens of the Americas’ poorest nation cheering the Salvadoran president’s ’shoot first, ask questions later’ method of dealing with the gangs that have overrun their country the past six years. Can the police force deployed actually restore law and order? We’ll ask about the latest in a decades-long list of efforts by the international community to support Haiti.
